name: mv
description: Moves one or more sources to a destination. On the same file system, the operation is instant: only the name or location changes. Renaming a file is simply “moving” it to a new name.

options.description: Asks for confirmation before overwriting an existing file.
Moves only if the source is newer than the destination.
Backs up the destination file (~ suffix) before overwriting it.
Moves every source into this directory.

examples.explanation: Moves every PDF in the current directory to ~/Documents.
Renames a directory, with confirmation and output.

dangerNote: If the destination exists, it is replaced without confirmation. Use -i or -n to avoid this.
